summary: Beaver Mountain (Wallowa-Whitman NF, Union Co., OR): 1920 pole platform, 1936 30-ft L-5 tower, gone in the 1940s; thin sources and no description of the site today.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower with L-5 cab (1936), after a 30-foot pole platform (1920)
facts.status_note: Gone in the 1940s per the Former Fire Lookout Sites register; no source read describes the site today

access.note: No source read says whether the site is open to the public

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Former Fire Lookout Sites); Wallowa-Whitman National Forest (Forest Lookouts)

events.note: 30-foot pole platform built on the site (register 'Built' field and description)
30-foot pole tower with L-5 cab constructed (register); firelookout.com gives a 7x7-foot cab
Register gives only 'the 1940's' and firelookout.com 'Abandoned 1940s'; the year 1940 is an approximation, not a documented date
Registered November 18, 2019; nominated by Tammy McLeod

evidence.supports: 30-foot pole platform built on the site in 1920
evidence.quote: A 30 foot pole platform was built on the site in 1920.

evidence.supports: 30-foot pole tower with L-5 cab constructed in 1936

The lookout was gone in the 1940's.

location Wallowa-Whitman National Forest, Union County, Oregon
site listed under the Wallowa-Whitman National Forest

corrections.why: Register gives 'Removed 1940's' and firelookout.com gives 'Abandoned 1940s'; neither source gives 1940 itself

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register gives 6,080 ft (1,853 m); firelookout.com gives 6040 ft. The register figure is used because it matches the existing record.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only the register and firelookout.com give dates, and the Forest Lookouts page has only the site name, forest and 'Removed'. No staffing or fire history appears in any source read, so none is recorded. Brief record checked: gone, U.S. Forest Service, 1920 and 2019 dates match; the 1940 removal year is approximate (see corrections). Height 9.1 m is 30 ft and refers to the 1936 tower. The register's photo caption reads 'Beaver Mountain Lookout 1920 - 1936', which may describe a photo span only; it is not used as evidence of removal. A Wallowa-Whitman lookouts ArcGIS app appeared in search results but was not read. The lat/long differs slightly between the register (45.13715, -118.16262) and firelookout.org (45.13737, -118.16270); the register figure is kept. No photo URLs recorded.
